name: Aishah Rahman
bio:
Aishah's journey into motorsport PR was somewhat unconventional, starting with a degree in communications followed by a stint in corporate marketing. However, her passion for racing, ignited during her childhood watching Formula 1 with her father, never waned. She made the switch to motorsport, leveraging her marketing skills to build brand awareness and manage media relations for smaller racing teams before landing a role at Cadillac Racing.

Aishah is known for her meticulous approach to public relations, ensuring every detail is meticulously planned and executed. Her ability to see the bigger picture allows her to craft compelling narratives that resonate with both hardcore racing fans and a broader audience. She prides herself on being adaptable, able to handle the fast-paced and often unpredictable nature of motorsport with grace and professionalism. Aishah is committed to helping Cadillac Racing maintain a positive brand image.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy hair with subtle highlights, often tied back in a low ponytail during races.
physical.description: Aishah is a slender woman with a warm smile and a keen, observant gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Malaysian teh tarik (milk tea) before any major race.
